correctness.rationale: A bijective 16-state transfer includes all open-boundary tests. Exact integer-polynomial certificate recomputes every entry of a monic degree-16 matrix annihilator, the first sixteen zero residuals for an order-five recurrence, and the five numerator polynomials, proving the generating-function identity for every n. The full minimizer classification follows separately from perfect crossing-edge matching and boundary propagation; asymptotics from the unique dominant simple pole. Direct brute force n=2..8 corroborates, not replaces, the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The all-size distribution is a natural refinement of the newly studied capacity-constrained domination of Cartesian grids, beyond the known numerical minimum. Exact finite-state algebra yields an explicit short rational function and new exponential growth rate, and complete minimum-configuration enumeration exposes an open-boundary parity transition. These are not cosmetic reformulations of the general half-order bound.
